Topic: According Judith Butler, one’s gender isn’t defined by the societal binary, but a repetitive performance of acts that so often correlate with the two sides, man and woman. Thus it’s possible for those questioning such a system to perform outside of the norm and try new things. The internet can offer safe places, free of scrutiny and the threat of reprimands and harm from deviating from the norm. Also consider how even though the performances Butler describes typically happen subconconciously, in physical space. The online space is an introduction and stepping stone into the practice for those who don’t even know what they are seeking.
